side_missions.title: Wolves at the Gate
side_missions.description: The Iron Wolves have been running silent through the Iron Expanse, and that never means anything good. Aristotle needs eyes on their fleet movements before they make their play for the crystal lanes.

objectives.description: Scout Iron Wolf fleet positions in the Expanse
Intercept and decode Wolf pack communications
Deliver the intelligence to your allies

side_missions.title: The Knight's Gambit
side_missions.description: Ser Galvain has reached out through back channels. A faction of the Knight Orders wants to break from their ancient alliance and chart an independent course. They need someone to vouch for them — someone with crystal leverage.

objectives.description: Meet the dissident Knight faction at the neutral point
Escort the Knight envoy through contested space

side_missions.title: Iron Veins
side_missions.description: Deep in the Iron Expanse lies a decommissioned mining station rumoured to sit atop an untapped crystal vein. Every faction wants it. Aristotle plans to get there first and stake a claim the old-fashioned way.

objectives.description: Navigate the hazardous Iron Expanse to the station
Clear and secure the abandoned mining station
Extract crystal samples from the vein

side_missions.title: Trust, but Verify
side_missions.description: Rumours have reached Aristotle that Dave has been making moves behind his back — or maybe someone wants him to think that. Either way, trust is a currency that's running low. Time to find out who's spending it.

objectives.description: Track the source of the loyalty rumours
Confront the truth — whatever it is
